milestones.title: Set Your Budget
milestones.description: Determine total budget with your partner and contributing family members.

milestones.title: Start Guest List Draft
milestones.description: Create a preliminary guest list to help determine venue size.

milestones.title: Book Wedding Venue
milestones.description: Secure your ceremony and reception venues with signed contracts.

milestones.title: Choose Wedding Party
milestones.description: Ask your bridesmaids, groomsmen, and other attendants.

milestones.title: Book Photographer
milestones.description: Hire your wedding photographer and videographer.

milestones.title: Book Caterer
milestones.description: Select and contract your catering company after tastings.

milestones.title: Order Wedding Dress
milestones.description: Purchase your wedding gown with time for delivery and alterations.

milestones.title: Send Save-the-Dates
milestones.description: Mail save-the-date cards to all guests on your list.

milestones.title: Create Wedding Website
milestones.description: Launch your wedding website with details and RSVP form.

milestones.title: Set Up Gift Registry
milestones.description: Register at 2-3 stores across various price points.

milestones.title: Book Florist
milestones.description: Hire your floral designer and discuss seasonal options.

milestones.title: Book Entertainment
milestones.description: Hire your DJ, band, or other entertainment.

milestones.title: Book Officiant
milestones.description: Secure your ceremony officiant and discuss ceremony format.

milestones.title: Order Bridesmaids Dresses
milestones.description: Choose and order bridesmaid attire with time for delivery.

milestones.title: Finalize Guest List
milestones.description: Lock in your final guest count with both families.

milestones.title: Order Invitations
milestones.description: Design, proof, and order your wedding invitations.

milestones.title: Book Transportation
milestones.description: Arrange wedding day transportation for the couple and guests.

milestones.title: Plan Honeymoon
milestones.description: Book flights, hotel, and activities for your honeymoon.

milestones.title: Book Hair & Makeup
milestones.description: Schedule trials and book your beauty team for the big day.

milestones.title: Order Groom's Attire
milestones.description: Purchase or rent the groom's suit or tuxedo.

milestones.title: Shop for Wedding Rings
milestones.description: Select wedding bands with time for sizing and engraving.

milestones.title: Apply for Marriage License
milestones.description: Research requirements and submit your marriage license application.

milestones.title: Mail Invitations
milestones.description: Send out all wedding invitations with RSVP deadline.

milestones.title: Begin Dress Alterations
milestones.description: Start fitting appointments for your wedding dress.

milestones.title: RSVP Deadline
milestones.description: Follow up with non-responders and finalize your headcount.

milestones.title: Submit Final Headcount
milestones.description: Give your caterer the confirmed guest count and meal selections.

milestones.title: Create Seating Chart
milestones.description: Assign guests to tables and order place cards.

milestones.title: Final Dress Fitting
milestones.description: Pick up your finished wedding gown after last alterations.

milestones.title: Confirm All Vendors
milestones.description: Reconfirm every vendor with final timeline and logistics.

milestones.title: Wedding Rehearsal
milestones.description: Walk through the ceremony and enjoy the rehearsal dinner.

milestones.title: Wedding Day!
milestones.description: Celebrate the love of your life — you have planned everything perfectly!
